Types of triangles

Triangles can be classified into three types with respect to their interior angles which are

Types of triangles

Acute angled triangle

A triangle in which all the angles are acute i.e. less than 90°

Types of triangles

Obtuse angled triangle

One of the angles of the triangle is greater than 90°

Types of triangles

Right angled triangle

A triangle in which one of the angles is 90 degrees.

Hypotenuse is the side opposite to the right angle and is the longest side.

Properties of triangles

Angle sum property

Property of triangles

Angle sum property

As per the angle sum property, the sum of the three interior angles of a triangle is always 180°.

In the given figure,

∠P + ∠Q + ∠R = 180°

Property of triangles

Triangle inequality property

As per the triangle inequality theorem, the sum of the length of the two sides of a triangle is greater than the third side.

In the given figure,

a + b > c

c + a > b

c + b > a

Property of triangles

Pythogoras theorem

In a right angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides.

Hypotenuse2 = Base2 + Altitude2
